text: tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . mano na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . dhammā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti . manoviññāṇaṃ na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . manosamphasso na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ
